contribution: The paper supplied a6CNOT logical template. Exact support search replaces its triangular affine suffix by a4CNOT square suffix. A real Schmidt decomposition of the initial two-qubit state then removes one more entangler. The complete native circuit uses5CZ in7moments.
limitations: This is one exact D4k2 preparation, not a reusable all-count decoder.
No global depth optimality or hardware-score gain is established.
The six-CNOT alternative matches9moments and is retained as a research result.
extend.py was prepared but not run after the exact Schmidt-prefix improvement; no extended-search result is claimed.
next: Independently export/validate the full portfolio and test calibrated primary performance against a fresh maintained baseline.
